card.title: IPhone 11 Pro and iPhone 11 Pro Max Not Powering on, 2a or Higher Power Draw After Prompt to Boot

source.title: IPhone 11 Pro and iPhone 11 Pro Max Not Powering on, 2a or Higher Power Draw After Prompt to Boot

claims.statement: iPhone 11 Pro / Pro Max drawing 2 A+: likely shorted cap on PP_VDD_MAIN or PP_VDD_BOOST, or a cracked U_NFC in the bottom board; split the sandwich to localise top vs bottom.

procedure: Inject 4 V / 2 A; remove the hot cap; check U_NFC.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
